==Biography==
HolyPhoenix competed at [[IEM Season IX - Cologne]] with [[Aces High Esports Club]] after the team won the [[IEM_Season_IX_-_Cologne/Qualifiers#Final_Qualifier|Turkish Qualifier]] for the tournament. Aces High were knocked out in the quarterfinals, losing to [[Team Dignitas]], despite taking a game off the North American team.

== Trivia ==
* He is known for his aggressive {{ci|Kalista}} and {{ci|Tristana}}.
* He is the first Turkish player who made it to Challenger on the EU West server.
* Is nicknamed "Khal Drogo" due to his similar appearance to the ''Game of Thrones'' character.
